text.name: Abomasnow

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Toughness Boost
abilities.text: Your Single Strike Pokémon in play, except any Abomasnow, get +50 HP. You can't apply more than 1 Toughness Boost Ability at a time.

text.flavor: This Pokémon is known to bring blizzards. A shake of its massive body is enough to cause whiteout conditions.

text.name: Delibird

attacks.name: Package Delivery
attacks.text: Put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck. If you do, search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it's always scrounging around for more food.

rules.label: V rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Ride of the High King
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Max Lance
attacks.text: You may discard up to 2 Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 120 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.

rules.label: VMAX rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

text.name: Lapras

attacks.name: Aqua Wash
attacks.text: You may put 2 Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon into their hand.

text.flavor: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

text.name: Beartic

attacks.name: Frozen Slice
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.

text.flavor: It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey. From its frozen breath, it forms icy fangs that are harder than steel.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Cold Absorption
abilities.text: Whenever you attach a {Water} Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon during your turn, heal 30 damage from it.

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.text: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

rules.label: V rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
